text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love got injured.
I rushed her to the nurse's office, and—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
Please, do not worry so much.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'm okay.
...Really, I'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
It doesn't hurt all that much.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
More importantly,
you look like you're the one
who got hurt...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I snap to my senses and slap my cheeks.
I shouldn't be making an anxious face.
I quickly pull myself together and put on a smile.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...What a kind person.
It's precisely because of your kindness...
that I can keep giving it my all."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer.
Please let me continue training.
I won't cause you any more worry...
choice_data_list: Let's wait until after you've had a proper rest.
If you're pushing yourself too hard—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, understood.
Training is something that should be done in peak condition, after all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'll get well soon.
So I can make up for the time I rested...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I am not pushing myself in the slightest.
Even now, see—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... hah...
I am... truly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"This is...
Just as you said, Trainer,
I ought to rest..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the injury has worsened...
For now, prioritizing healing the injury was the right call.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No, I want to do it.
It's only light exercise, and—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If you judge it to be impossible, Trainer,
I will stop immediately.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Thank you very much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
It seems this level of exercise
poses no problems after all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Is it... because you're watching over me
even more closely than usual, Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Just... kidding.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: N-Now then... I will continue...!
